jobs.occupation: Cook for asian food
jobs.description:
Er du en dygtig og erfaren asiatisk kok til fortrinvis kinesisk mad, så er det dig vi har brug for.
Restauranten er dedikeret til at tilbyde vores gæster en unik og autentisk asiatisk madoplevelse. 

Dine daglige opgaver er bl.a.:

• Bestilling og modtagelse af varer

• Opfølgning og tilsyn med takeaway ordrer og gæsternes med i restauranten

• Udvikle dele af køkkenmenuen i samarbejde med køkkenchefen

Du er glad, og smilendei din tilgang til andre mennesker, gæster såvel som kollegaer, også når der er travlt.

Når du starter, får du grundig oplæring og vi sørger for, at du løbende får ledelsestræning, så du bliver endnu bedre til at drive og udvikle køkkenet.

Dine arbejdstimer ligger indenfor 12-22 og bliver fordelt via vagtplan.

Dette er et krav at du behersker engelsk: I køkkenet arbejder flere forskellige nationaliteter og restaurantpersonalet er fortrinvis danskere.

Har du ikke hørt fra is indenfor 14 dage, er det fordi jobbet er blevet besat.

 

Cook for Asian food

If you are a skilled and experienced Asian chef with excellent Chinese food, then we need you.

The restaurant is dedicated to offering our guests a unique and authentic Asian dining experience.

Your daily tasks include:

• Ordering and receiving goods

• Follow-up and supervision of takeaway orders and guest's food in the restaurant

• Develop parts of the kitchen menu in collaboration with the chef

You are happy and smiling in your approach to other people, guests as well as colleagues,
even when it is hectic.

When you start, you will receive thorough training and we will ensure you continuously receive management training, so you become even better at running and developing the kitchen.

Your working hours are between 12-22 and are distributed via shift schedule.

Mastering English is a requirement: Several different nationalities work in the kitchen,  and the restaurant staff are mainly Danes. 

If you haven't heard from us within 14 days, it's because the job has been filled.

jobs.occupation: Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice (2-Year Program)
jobs.description:
Automobility-X is a growing company based in Ikast, Denmark, specializing in mobility and vehicle solutions. We work with customers and suppliers across Europe and beyond, giving you the opportunity to gain valuable international experience. As part of our small team, you will work across different areas of the business and take on real responsibility from day one.

We are looking for a motivated and proactive Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice who is eager to develop practical skills in sales, administration, marketing, and international trade.

About the apprenticeship

This is a full-time, 2-year apprenticeship (approximately 37 hours per week). During the program, you will receive thorough training and work closely with experienced colleagues who will support your development.

You will be involved in the company's daily operations, communicate with customers and suppliers from around the world, and gain practical experience in an international business environment. For the right candidate, the apprenticeship may lead to a permanent position after completion.

Your responsibilities

• Preparing and following up on quotations 

• Processing customer orders and coordinating deliveries 

• Communicating with customers and suppliers 

• Administrative tasks and invoicing 

• Supporting marketing activities and social media 

• Maintaining product documentation and internal systems 

• Assisting with various ad hoc tasks 

We are looking for someone who

• Is positive, motivated, and enjoys working with people 

• Has an interest in sales, administration, and business 

• Is well organized and takes responsibility for their work 

• Enjoys working in a team and communicating with customers 

• Can manage several tasks in a fast-paced environment 

• Has good English skills (an additional language is an advantage) 

• Is familiar with Microsoft Office 

• Is eager to learn and ready to take on new challenges 

What we offer

• A varied and exciting 2-year apprenticeship 

• Responsibility from the beginning and the opportunity to make an impact 

• An international working environment with customers and suppliers worldwide 

• Close collaboration with experienced colleagues 

• Professional and personal development throughout the apprenticeship 

• Hands-on experience in sales, administration, marketing, logistics, and international trade 

• The possibility of permanent employment after successfully completing the apprenticeship 

Location: Automobility-X ApS, Thrigesvej 37E, 7430 Ikast, Denmark

Start date: By agreement

How to apply:

Please send your CV and a short motivational letter in English or Danish to zofie@am-x.dk. We would like to learn more about you, why you are interested in joining Automobility-X, and what motivates you.

We value genuine, personal applications over generic or AI-generated submissions.

Questions?

If you have any questions about the apprenticeship or the application process, please contact:

Zofie Jarosova, Operations Manager zofie@am-x.dk, +45 5239 344

jobs.occupation: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Business Operations Coordinator søges

Vil du være med til at udvikle en voksende kæde af neglesaloner?

Vi søger en struktureret og forretningsorienteret Business Operations Coordinator, som kan hjælpe os med at optimere driften, forbedre økonomien og styrke kundeoplevelsen på tværs af vores saloner.

Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for ejeren og får stor indflydelse på virksomhedens udvikling.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

• 
Analysere virksomhedens økonomi, nøgletal og KPI'er.

• 
Udarbejde ugentlige og månedlige rapporter til ejeren.

• 
Identificere muligheder for at reducere omkostninger og øge indtjeningen.

• 
Optimere arbejdsgange og implementere effektive processer.

• 
Sikre ensartet kvalitet og en høj kundeoplevelse på tværs af alle saloner.

• 
Bidrage til udvikling og styrkelse af virksomhedens brand.

• 
Følge op på salonenes performance og foreslå konkrete forbedringer.

• 
Samarbejde tæt med salonlederne for at sikre en effektiv og velfungerende drift.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har erfaring med drift, business operations eller projektledelse.

• 
Er stærk inden for analyse, talforståelse og rapportering.

• 
Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik.

• 
Er proaktiv, løsningsorienteret og ser muligheder frem for problemer.

• 
Har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner.

• 
Behersker både dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse.

• 
Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

• 
Tæt samarbejde med ejeren og korte beslutningsveje.

• 
Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede og dygtige kolleger.

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt.

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater til samtale løbende og forbeholder os retten til at besætte stillingen, før ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Business Operations Coordinator hiring

Are you passionate about improving business performance and helping a growing company succeed?

We are looking for a structured and business-oriented Business Operations Coordinator to help optimize our operations, improve financial performance, and enhance the customer experience across our nail salon locations.

You will work closely with the owner as a trusted business partner and play an important role in the company's continued growth and development.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Analyze the company's financial performance, key metrics, and KPIs.

• 
Prepare weekly and monthly management reports for the owner.

• 
Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.

• 
Optimize workflows and implement efficient operational processes.

• 
Ensure consistent service quality and an excellent customer experience across all salon locations.

• 
Contribute to the development and strengthening of the company's brand.

• 
Monitor the performance of each salon and recommend practical improvements.

• 
Work closely with salon managers to ensure efficient day-to-day operations.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has experience in business operations, operations management, or project management.

• 
Possesses strong analytical, financial, and reporting skills.

• 
Is highly organized with excellent planning and coordination abilities.

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for improvement.

• 
Has excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Is fluent in both Danish and English, spoken and written.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting and varied role with significant influence on the company's development.

• 
The opportunity to make a real impact in a growing business.

• 
Close collaboration with the owner and a fast decision-making environment.

• 
An informal and friendly workplace with dedicated colleagues.

• 
A competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

Application Deadline: As soon as possible.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Therefore, the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to receiving your application!
